lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Grade 12 na! Huling taon sa Senior High School. Biglang ramdam ang pressure: Work Immersion, Research Defense, College Entrance Tests (CETs), at scholarship deadlines.
lines.textEn: Grade 12! Your final year of Senior High School. Suddenly everything hits at once: Work Immersion, Research Defense, College Entrance Tests, and scholarship deadlines.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Ready na ba kayo sa CET applications? Ang mahal ng exam fee sa ibang university — pero libre sa State U kung maaga tayo magpapasa!
lines.textEn: Ready for CET applications? Private university exam fees are pricey — but State U is free if we file early!

choices.text: Mag-apply sa State U at mag-review nang todo!
choices.textEn: Apply to State U and review hard!

choices.text: Mag-apply sa 3 universities para may backup (-₱350 exam fees).
choices.textEn: Apply to 3 universities for backup (-₱350 exam fees).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Nakahiram ako ng lumang CET reviewer mula sa pinsan ko! Pass-the-reviewer culture to the rescue — walang pambayad sa review center eh!
lines.textEn: I borrowed an old CET reviewer from my cousin! Pass-the-reviewer culture to the rescue — none of us can afford a review center!

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Photocopy natin sa labas tapos mag-mock exam tayo ngayong hapon, {name}?
lines.textEn: Let us photocopy it outside and run a timed mock exam this afternoon, {name}?

choices.text: G! Mag-mock exam kasama sina Bea at Jamie (-₱45 photocopy).
choices.textEn: Yes! Run the mock exam with Bea and Jamie (-₱45 photocopy).

choices.text: Kopyahin ko na lang sa notebook para zero gastos (-Energy).
choices.textEn: Copy the key problems by hand to spend zero pesos (-Energy).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Araw ng College Entrance Test! Malamig ang testing room, hawak mo ang Mongol #2 pencil na sinabihan ni Mama na huwag ihuhulog.
lines.textEn: College Entrance Test day! Freezing testing room, gripping your Mongol #2 pencil that Mama warned you never to drop.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Bro, 5 minutes na lang sa Math portion at may 10 items pa akong blangko! Dasal na lang talaga at letter C!
lines.textEn: Bro, 5 minutes left on Math and I still have 10 blanks! Pure prayers and letter C at this point!

choices.text: Huminga nang malalim at tapusin nang maayos ang bawat tanong.
choices.textEn: Take a deep breath and methodically solve each remaining item.

journal.title: College Entrance Test
journal.summary: Hinarap mo ang CET dala ang Mongol #2 pencil at reviewer ng barkada.
journal.summaryEn: Tackled the College Entrance Test armed with a Mongol #2 pencil and shared reviewers.

choices.text: Mag-speed run sa dulo para walang maiwang blanko.
choices.textEn: Speed-run the final items so nothing stays blank.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Tapos na ang CET! Kahit anong resulta, proud ako sa atin. Sabay-sabay tayong lalaban sa college!
lines.textEn: CET is done! Whatever the result, I am proud of us. We are fighting through college together!

choices.text: Cheers ng iced water at sisig rice! (-₱65)
choices.textEn: Cheers with iced water and sisig rice! (-₱65)

choices.text: Babalik muna ako sa trabaho para bawiin ang pamasahe.
choices.textEn: Heading straight to a shift to earn back the fare.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: {name}, bukas na ang application para sa Iskolar ng Bayan / CHED College Scholarship! Kung mapasa mo ang documents, essay, at interview, malaking bawas 'to sa tuition mo sa {course}!
lines.textEn: {name}, applications just opened for the Iskolar ng Bayan / CHED College Scholarship! Pass the documents, essay, and interview and it covers a huge chunk of your {course} tuition!

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Subukan mo na, anak! Kahit maglakad tayo sa munisipyo para kumuha ng Certificate of Indigency, sasamahan kita.
lines.textEn: Go for it, anak! Even if we have to walk to city hall for the Certificate of Indigency, I will go with you.

choices.text: Mag-apply ngayon! (Start Scholarship Application Quest)
choices.textEn: Apply now! (Start Scholarship Application Quest)

choices.text: Paghandaan ko muna ang grades ko — sa college na lang ako mag-apply.
choices.textEn: I will focus on my grades first and apply during college.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Disyembre na! Kumikislap ang mga capiz parol sa buong kalye at amoy bibingka at puto bumbong pagkatapos ng Simbang Gabi.
lines.textEn: December has arrived! Capiz parol lanterns glow down the block, and warm bibingka and puto bumbong perfume the dawn air after Simbang Gabi.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Merry Christmas, {name}! Eto, maliit na regalo lang — lucky ballpen at pouch para sa college natin next year.
lines.textEn: Merry Christmas, {name}! Here is a small gift — a lucky pen and pouch for college next year.

choices.text: Bilhan ng mainit na bibingka si Jamie at mag-uwi rin kay Mama (-₱110).
choices.textEn: Buy warm bibingka for Jamie and bring some home for Mama (-₱110).

choices.text: Mag-part-time Christmas rush shift sa fastfood (+₱450).
choices.textEn: Work the holiday rush shift at fastfood (+₱450).

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Practical Research 2 Defense! Panelist ako ngayon. Ipaliwanag niyo kung bakit valid ang sample size ninyo — walang binabasa sa PowerPoint!
lines.textEn: Practical Research 2 Defense! I am on the panel today. Defend your sample size — no reading off the slides!

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: {name}, ikaw na mag-deliver ng methodology! Nanginginig na tuhod ko!
lines.textEn: {name}, take the methodology section! My knees are shaking!

choices.text: Tumayo nang tuwid at ipagtanggol ang research nang malinaw!
choices.textEn: Stand tall and defend the methodology with confidence!

choices.text: Hatiin niyo ni Bea ang sagot para pareho kayong makabawi.
choices.textEn: Split the answers with Bea so both of you shine.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Approved with minor revisions! Congratulations, group! Handa na kayo sa totoong thesis sa college.
lines.textEn: Approved with minor revisions! Congratulations, group! You are ready for real college thesis battles.

choices.text: Magdiwang nang mabilis at i-bind na ang final manuscript (-₱85).
choices.textEn: Celebrate briefly and print-bind the final manuscript (-₱85).

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: Magaling ka sa SHS Work Immersion mo, {name}! Nag-iwan ka ng magandang impresyon. Kung gusto mo ng part-time bago ka mag-college, bukas ang pinto namin.
lines.textEn: Great job on your SHS Work Immersion, {name}! You left a strong impression. If you need part-time hours before college, our door is open.

choices.text: Tanggapin ang referral letter at extra weekend shift (+₱380).
choices.textEn: Accept the recommendation letter and a paid weekend shift (+₱380).

choices.text: Kunin ang recommendation letter at umuwi para magpahinga.
choices.textEn: Take the recommendation letter and head home to rest.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, dumating na ang sulat para sa SHS Graduation toga rental at grad pic — ₱650 lahat. Tapos next month, enrollan na rin sa college...
lines.textEn: Anak, the letter arrived for SHS Graduation toga rental and grad photos — ₱650 total. And next month is college enrollment...

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Sigurado ka bang itutuloy mo ang {course} sa college? Kung gusto mo muna mag-trabaho ng isang taon, maiintindihan naman namin ni Tatay...
lines.textEn: Are you sure about pursuing {course} right away? If you want to work first, Tatay and I would understand...

choices.text: 'Itutuloy ko ang {course}, Ma! Ako na magbabayad ng toga rental ko!' (-₱650)
choices.textEn: 'I am pushing through with {course}, Ma! I will cover my own toga fee!' (-₱650)

choices.text: Manghiram muna ng toga sa nakaraang batch — ipon natin sa college enrollment! (-₱150)
choices.textEn: Borrow a toga from an older batchmate — save the rest for college! (-₱150)

choices.text: 'Baka mag-stop muna ako para mag-full time trabaho, Ma...'
choices.textEn: 'Maybe I should stop and work full-time for our family, Ma...'

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, sigurado ka ba? Hindi kita pipilitin kung pagod ka na sa gastos — pero pwede pa tayong lumaban kung gusto mong ituloy ang college.
lines.textEn: Are you truly sure, anak? I will not force you if the costs feel too heavy — but we can still fight for college if you want to try.

choices.text: Hindi, Ma — lalaban ako! Papasok ako sa college!
choices.textEn: No, Ma — I will fight! I am going to college!

choices.text: Buo na ang loob ko, Ma. Magtatrabaho muna ako para makabangon tayo.
choices.textEn: My mind is made up, Ma. I will work first to lift our family up.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Nakakaiyak ka naman, {name}! Sige, ilaban natin 'yang {course} mo. Kahit barya-barya, makakarating ka rin sa entablado!
lines.textEn: You are going to make me cry, {name}! Alright, let us fight for your {course} degree. Even coin by coin, you will reach that stage!

choices.text: Maghanda na para sa SHS Graduation!
choices.textEn: Get ready for SHS Graduation!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: SHS GRADUATION DAY! Suot mo ang toga, may sampaguita lei sa leeg, at tinawag ang pangalan mo sa entablado: '{name} — {strand}!'
lines.textEn: SHS GRADUATION DAY! Wearing your toga with a fragrant sampaguita lei, your name echoes across the gym: '{name} — {strand}!'

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, ang galing mo! Unang hakbang pa lang 'yan — susunod na ang kolehiyo!
lines.textEn: You did amazing, anak! Just the first milestone — next stop, college!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Group pic muna! Tandaan niyo, kahit magkahiwa-hiwalay ng course sa college, walang iwanan sa GC ha!
lines.textEn: Group photo first! Remember, even with different college courses, nobody leaves the group chat!

choices.text: Pasalamatan si Mama, barkada, at si Prof. Reyes — College na tayo!
choices.textEn: Thank Mama, the barkada, and Prof. Reyes — on to College!

journal.title: SHS Graduate!
journal.summary: Nagtapos ka sa Senior High School ({strand})! Handa ka na sa bagong laban sa {course}.
journal.summaryEn: Graduated from Senior High School ({strand})! Ready for the {course} chapter.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: {name}, a-attend ka ba ng Senior Night? ₱450 ang ticket... pero sabi nila once in a lifetime daw 'to.
lines.textEn: {name}, are you going to Senior Night? Tickets are ₱450... everyone says it is once in a lifetime.

choices.text: Oo, Jamie! Sasayaw tayo kahit hiram ang polo/dress! (-₱450)
choices.textEn: Yes, Jamie! Let us dance even in borrowed outfits! (-₱450)

choices.text: Mag-street food date na lang tayo pagkatapos ng shift ko — mas masaya at tipid! (-₱80)
choices.textEn: Let us do a street food hangout after my shift instead — more fun and budget-friendly! (-₱80)

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Uy, tiningnan mo na ba ang curriculum ng {course}? May libreng online PDF modules na binigay 'yung alumni natin!
lines.textEn: Hey, have you checked the {course} curriculum yet? Our alumni shared free PDF intro modules!

choices.text: I-download at basahin nang maaga para hindi ma-culture shock sa college!
choices.textEn: Save and read them early so college doesn't blindside you!

choices.text: Salamat Bea! Save ko muna sa flash drive.
choices.textEn: Thanks Bea! Saving them on my flash drive for later.

lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Malapit ka nang lumuwas mula {hometown} papuntang Manila para sa college, {name}. Ingat ka sa mandurukot at lagi kang kumain sa oras ha.
lines.textEn: Soon you will leave {hometown} for Manila for college, {name}. Watch out for pickpockets and always eat on time.

choices.text: Promise po, Tay, Nay! Araw-araw ako magte-text pag-uwi sa boarding house.
choices.textEn: I promise, Tay, Nay! I will message every night when I get back to the boarding house.
